notes.title: Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity 1.07 "Home" & "Mod"
notes.content:
New features Home and Mod! Unlocked in the pause menu (along the "Eye" row) at 100 and 10 § respectively.   
[previewyoutube=kAaXSImrHdE;full][/previewyoutube]
* Performance improvements, notably on spawning objects such as on some Earth levels.
* New "Mod" mode allows a variety of graphical customizations! This includes saturation overriding, post processing override, post process randomization, and a new "off" option.  
* New "Home" mode is a type of trophy room which will fill in as your progress.

Now, with Mod and Home, there are 3 meta-menus that unlock at 1, 10 and 100§!
Combining Mod with the Sharp Style and Simplified Backgrounds options from the Options menu allows even more visual styles.

notes.title: Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity 1.06
notes.content:
* New: Press any transform key during Eye mode to cycle the screen saturation.
* Restored Lie intro background effect.

notes.title: Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity 1.05
notes.content: * Split the "Hide UI" option into two options: Hide UI which hides the hotkey bar and § display, and "Hide Target Icons" which hides the icons on pickups/etc. By enabling Hide UI but not not "Hide Target Icons," you can now play with just the icons but not the rest of the UI.

notes.title: Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity 1.04 "Eye" update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=i6qJBrdsjAI;full][/previewyoutube]

* New "Eye" mode available once you have 1§ (free fly camera for screenshotting and looking around, you'll jump back to your actual position when you click menu from Eye; the Eye does not see icons however, unlike Look).
* Minor bugs related to script and pause menu form radar (red blob).

notes.title: Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity 1.03
notes.content:
* New "Simplified Graphics" options from the opening photosensitivity disclaimer screen: Enable to activate all graphical accessibility modes.  You can continue to manually turn the 3 settings (Reduced Animation, Sharp Mode, Simplified Backgrounds) on/off if you leave this option toggled off.
* New graphics preview pane in the opening screen, to show some examples of the Simplified Graphics option.
* New effect during the syringe animation (on levels outside of Earth and Digital spaces) to saturate the environment temporarily (you'll still need to collect § to explore the saturated environment!).
* Corrected a hole in the Ex-Site region to properly go to the "Extreme Evolution Experiment" title card rather than the Before level itself.

[previewyoutube=JLm2_Or4jl0;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you!
Sam Atlas

notes.title: Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity OUT NOW
notes.content:
Extreme Evolution is the largest of my projects, a game about the multifaceted mystery of existence.
An ultimate freedom fantasy, forms limitless in ability to change, the game itself another layer of formless "nothing."  

The Space Hole trilogy was about movement; Extreme Evolution is movement.  There is no right or wrong way to live or to play Extreme Evolution. I invite you to break the game and overwhelm its logic, leaving behind wreckage of consciousness unbound.

[previewyoutube=qhXLkUdfTk4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: EE: The Body demo update 2.0
notes.content:
Updated Extreme Evolution: Drive to Divinity free demo version ("The Body"):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899859/2cfccf831054b5e6275184e7723d7376e76c0455.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Pause menu rework: menu is now significantly more organized and easier to use. Forms can be sorted in the form menu now (by their age, name, or their stat attributes), the site menu is now rendered with more perspective, and the hypostasis menu displays the sum of your attributes (a sum of your collected form attributes stat values).
[*]New desaturation effect: as you collect § in a given site, the saturation will fade in.  This effects all levels. This is also represented on the new site menu.
[*]Visual motif improvements, such as new starry motif in areas such as Crunchy Bone (which is the updated name of Bone Artery), and new fire in the Outer Divine Atrium. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899859/952348d24494adb429b9082df688820d0c239dc1.png[/img]
[*]Main menu reworked: fixed bug related to key rebinding, beatification, and now shows more preview information about the 3 save slots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899859/1310fe904314b955a8563b7037489be34dd550de.png[/img]
[*]New dynamic camera dampening & dynamic velocity system.
[*]New UI fade out system.
[*]Significant Performance improvements.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899859/bb60fa4b94b21c156875149ecbabc54cf64e16b2.png[/img]
[*]New secret area (ft. new music), the Chair Factory.
[*]Tweaks to various levels (both to add and remove pickups).[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899859/2c37144cb0dc06463bdfc1baf9d2e6ab4b598931.png[/img]
[*]Two game endings are now accessible from The Body.
[*]Balance changes to forms and sites.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899859/ad407e43832b9c82935cb6cfe451b84b6933386c.png[/img]
[/list]

The full version of Extreme Evolution is still coming later in 2023! It's going to be quite a bit larger than The Body demo.

[previewyoutube=MsR9wfGhZGw;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for playing!
Sam Atlas
